rubrics.notes: Four equally weighted criteria. Round the average to the nearest half band. Do not reward memorised answers.

bands.4: Cannot keep going without long pauses; ideas are linked mainly by repetition and simple connectors; coherence breaks down under strain.
bands.5: Usually keeps going but relies on repetition and self-correction; overuses a few connectives; some ideas are left unfinished.
bands.6: Speaks at length with some hesitation that does not impede meaning; uses a range of connectives but not always appropriately; ideas are generally ordered.
bands.7: Speaks fluently with only occasional repetition or self-correction; hesitation is content-related, not language-related; coherence is maintained with flexible linking.
bands.8: Speaks fluently and coherently with only very occasional hesitation; topic development is fully sustained and linking is natural.
bands.9: Fully fluent with natural, effortless coherence; hesitation is rare and used for effect; no noticeable effort.

bands.4: Vocabulary is adequate only for familiar topics; frequent word-choice errors; paraphrasing is rarely attempted.
bands.5: Manages familiar topics with limited flexibility; noticeable errors in word choice and collocation; paraphrasing is attempted with mixed success.
bands.6: Has enough vocabulary to discuss topics at length; uses some less common words with occasional inaccuracy; generally paraphrases successfully.
bands.7: Uses vocabulary flexibly and precisely on a range of topics; some idiomatic language; occasional slips that do not impede communication.
bands.8: Uses a wide, precise and natural vocabulary; skilful paraphrasing; rare errors only.
bands.9: Uses a fully precise, idiomatic and flexible vocabulary with natural collocation throughout.

bands.4: Produces basic sentence forms with frequent errors; complex structures are rare and usually inaccurate.
bands.5: Uses a limited range of structures; complex sentences are attempted but often contain errors that can cause misunderstanding.
bands.6: Uses a mix of simple and complex structures with some errors; errors rarely cause misunderstanding.
bands.7: Uses a range of complex structures with some flexibility; frequent error-free sentences; a few persistent errors remain.
bands.8: Uses a wide range of structures accurately; occasional slips only; most sentences are error-free.
bands.9: Uses a full range of structures naturally and accurately, with only slips characteristic of native speech.

bands.4: Pronunciation features are limited; frequent mispronunciation causes strain for the listener; little use of stress or intonation.
bands.5: Some features are controlled but errors are frequent; listener effort is required; stress and intonation are basic.
bands.6: Generally intelligible; some effective use of stress and intonation; occasional mispronunciation requires listener effort.
bands.7: Clear, natural pronunciation with effective stress and intonation; occasional lapses do not impede understanding.
bands.8: Easy to understand throughout; flexible use of stress, rhythm and intonation; minor accent features only.
bands.9: Fully intelligible with native-like control of stress, rhythm and intonation.

rubrics.notes: Task 1 requires a clear overview, accurate data selection and comparison. No conclusion or opinion is required. Under 150 words is penalised.

bands.4: Attempts the task but does not cover the main features; data may be inaccurate or missing; no clear overview.
bands.5: Recounts some key features but mechanically; overview may be unclear or absent; some data errors.
bands.6: Covers the main features with an overview; some details are irrelevant or inaccurate; comparison is present but limited.
bands.7: Clearly presents an overview and selects key features accurately; comparisons are well chosen; minor omissions only.
bands.8: Fully satisfies the task with a clear overview and well-selected, accurate data; skilful comparison.
bands.9: Fully satisfies all requirements with a fully developed, precise and well-selected account.

bands.4: Organisation is unclear; cohesive devices are limited or inaccurate; paragraphing is absent or unhelpful.
bands.5: Some organisation but links are mechanical; paragraphing may be inadequate; referencing is sometimes unclear.
bands.6: Logically organised with clear paragraphs; cohesive devices are used but sometimes mechanically; referencing is generally clear.
bands.7: Logically sequenced with clear progression; a range of cohesive devices is used flexibly; paragraphing is effective.
bands.8: Information is sequenced skilfully; cohesion is natural and unobtrusive; paragraphing is fully effective.
bands.9: Cohesion is seamless and fully controlled; paragraphing and referencing are entirely natural.

bands.4: Limited vocabulary; frequent spelling and word-formation errors; repetition is noticeable.
bands.5: Adequate vocabulary for the task but limited range; noticeable errors in spelling and collocation.
bands.6: Adequate range with some less common vocabulary; occasional errors in spelling and word choice that do not impede meaning.
bands.7: A sufficient range of vocabulary with some flexibility and precision; occasional errors in word choice, spelling or collocation.
bands.8: A wide range used fluently and precisely; rare errors only.
bands.9: A full, precise and natural range with only negligible slips.

bands.4: Limited structures with frequent errors that can distort meaning; punctuation is often faulty.
bands.5: Limited range; complex sentences are attempted but often inaccurate; errors can cause some difficulty.
bands.6: A mix of simple and complex forms; some errors but meaning is rarely affected; punctuation is generally controlled.
bands.7: A variety of complex structures with frequent error-free sentences; a few errors remain; good control of punctuation.
bands.8: A wide range of structures used accurately; occasional slips only; punctuation is well controlled.
bands.9: A full range of structures with near-perfect accuracy and punctuation.

rubrics.notes: Task 2 requires a clear position, developed ideas and a conclusion. Under 250 words is penalised. Memorised templates should not be rewarded.

bands.4: Addresses the task only minimally; position is unclear; ideas are irrelevant or repetitive; may be under length.
bands.5: Addresses the task only partially; position is present but underdeveloped; ideas are limited or inadequately supported.
bands.6: Addresses all parts of the task; a relevant position is presented but some ideas are not fully developed; conclusions may be unclear.
bands.7: Addresses all parts with a clear position throughout; main ideas are extended and supported; a relevant conclusion is drawn.
bands.8: Fully addresses the task with a well-developed position; ideas are relevant, extended and supported; conclusion is strong.
bands.9: Fully explores all parts with a fully developed, nuanced position and convincing support.

bands.4: Ideas are not arranged logically; cohesive devices are limited or inaccurate; paragraphing is absent.
bands.5: Some organisation but progression is unclear; cohesive devices are mechanical; paragraphing may be confusing.
bands.6: A clear overall progression; cohesive devices are used but sometimes mechanically; paragraphing is generally clear.
bands.7: Logically organised with clear progression; a range of cohesive devices is used flexibly; each paragraph has a clear central topic.
bands.8: Ideas are sequenced skilfully; cohesion is natural; paragraphing is fully effective.
bands.9: Cohesion is seamless and fully controlled throughout.

bands.4: Limited vocabulary; frequent errors in spelling and word choice; repetition impedes meaning.
bands.5: Limited range; noticeable errors in word choice, spelling and collocation; paraphrasing is limited.
bands.6: Adequate range with some less common vocabulary; occasional errors that do not impede communication.
bands.7: A sufficient range used flexibly and precisely; some idiomatic language; occasional slips only.
bands.8: A wide range used fluently and precisely; rare errors; effective paraphrasing.
bands.9: A full, precise and natural range with only negligible slips.

bands.4: Basic structures with frequent errors; complex sentences are rare; punctuation is often faulty.
bands.5: Limited range; complex forms are attempted but often inaccurate; errors can cause difficulty.
bands.6: A mix of simple and complex forms; some errors but meaning is rarely affected.
bands.7: A variety of complex structures with frequent error-free sentences; a few errors remain.
bands.8: A wide range of structures used accurately; occasional slips only.
bands.9: A full range of structures with near-perfect accuracy.

rubrics.notes: 2026 TOEFL iBT Speaking uses a 1-6 section scale. Listen and Repeat and Take an Interview items are each worth up to 5 points. Pronunciation cannot be judged from a transcript, so the app's text-only estimate excludes delivery.

bands.1: Speech is largely unintelligible or absent.
bands.2: Frequent fluency and pronunciation problems make meaning hard to follow.
bands.3: Generally intelligible with noticeable pacing or pronunciation problems that require listener effort.
bands.4: Clear and reasonably fluent, with minor delivery problems that do not impede meaning.
bands.5: Clear, fluent and natural, with effective pacing and intonation.

bands.1: Very limited grammar and vocabulary; frequent errors obscure meaning.
bands.2: Basic grammar and vocabulary; errors are noticeable and sometimes impede meaning.
bands.3: Effective grammar and vocabulary with some errors; meaning is clear.
bands.4: Accurate, varied grammar and vocabulary appropriate to the task.
bands.5: Precise, varied and accurate language throughout.

bands.1: Minimal content; ideas are unclear or unrelated.
bands.2: Some relevant ideas but limited development or weak connection to the task.
bands.3: Relevant, reasonably developed ideas with adequate support.
bands.4: Well-developed, organised ideas that address every part of the task.
bands.5: Fully developed, well-organised and precise content.

rubrics.notes: 2026 TOEFL iBT Writing uses a 1-6 section scale. Build a Sentence items are worth 1 point each; Write an Email and Write for an Academic Discussion are worth up to 5 points each.

bands.1: Minimal or irrelevant response; the task is not addressed.
bands.2: Partly relevant content with weak or missing support.
bands.3: Relevant content with adequate but uneven development.
bands.4: Well-developed content with clear support and accurate task coverage.
bands.5: Fully developed, precise and well-supported content.

bands.2: Some organisation but weak progression or paragraphing.
bands.3: Generally organised with clear paragraphs and some effective transitions.
bands.4: Clearly organised with logical progression and effective transitions.
bands.5: Skilfully organised with seamless progression.

bands.1: Very limited range with frequent errors that obscure meaning.
bands.2: Limited range with noticeable errors that sometimes impede meaning.
bands.3: Adequate range with some errors; meaning is generally clear.
bands.4: Effective range with few errors; clear and varied sentences.
bands.5: Precise, varied and accurate language throughout.

rubrics.notes: 英语一/二小作文按 10 分制。重点看格式、要点覆盖、语气得体与语言准确。

bands.3: 格式错误，要点大量缺失，难以达到交际目的。
bands.5: 格式基本正确，遗漏主要要点，语言错误较多。
bands.7: 格式正确，覆盖主要要点，表达基本得体，有少量语言错误。
bands.9: 格式规范，要点完整，语气得体，语言准确。
bands.10: 格式规范，要点完整且有细节支撑，语气得体，语言准确丰富。

bands.3: 句子之间缺乏衔接，结构混乱。
bands.5: 有一定结构，但衔接生硬，段落不清。
bands.7: 结构清晰，衔接自然，段落合理。
bands.10: 结构严谨，层次分明，衔接自然。

bands.3: 语法错误频繁，影响理解。
bands.5: 语法和词汇有限，错误较多但基本可读。
bands.7: 语法基本正确，词汇较丰富，偶有错误。
bands.9: 语法准确，词汇丰富，句式多样。
bands.10: 语法准确，词汇丰富地道，句式灵活。

rubrics.notes: 英语一大作文按 20 分制。必须描述图画、解释寓意并给出评论。

bands.6: 未描述图画或严重偏题，无明确寓意。
bands.10: 描述不完整，寓意不清，缺少评论。
bands.14: 描述了图画并点出寓意，评论较简单。
bands.17: 描述准确，寓意明确，论证较充分。
bands.20: 描述准确生动，寓意深刻，论证充分有力。

bands.6: 结构混乱，缺少段落划分。
bands.10: 结构松散，衔接手段有限。
bands.14: 结构完整，段落清晰，衔接基本自然。
bands.17: 结构严谨，层次分明，衔接自然。
bands.20: 结构严谨，层层递进，衔接流畅。

bands.6: 语法错误频繁，词汇贫乏，影响理解。
bands.10: 语法错误较多，词汇有限。
bands.14: 语法基本正确，词汇较丰富。
bands.17: 语法准确，词汇丰富，句式多样。
bands.20: 语法准确，词汇丰富地道，句式灵活多变。

rubrics.notes: 英语二大作文按 15 分制。必须描述图表、分析原因并给出结论。

bands.4: 未描述图表或数据严重错误，无分析。
bands.8: 描述不完整，原因分析薄弱。
bands.11: 描述了主要数据，有原因分析，结论简单。
bands.13: 数据描述准确，分析合理，结论明确。
bands.15: 数据描述准确全面，分析深入，结论有说服力。

bands.4: 结构混乱，缺少衔接。
bands.15: 结构严谨，层次分明，衔接流畅。

bands.4: 语法错误频繁，影响理解。
bands.8: 语法错误较多，词汇有限。
bands.11: 语法基本正确，词汇较丰富。
bands.15: 语法准确，词汇丰富地道，句式多样。
